primitives.verbatim_quote: The best catchers make this kinid of a pocket for the ball, using the hands and arms to catch it, and also the body to make it sure, sometimes even drawing up the leg a trifle; but this last is hardly necessary.

primitives.assumptions: The human receiver acts as a continuous deformable boundary capable of expanding V_p dynamically to absorb \Delta p without rebound.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when V_p approaches zero (hands-only baseball catch) or when structural rigidity prevents dynamic expansion under high-energy flux.
